ESTABLISHED FACTS & MEASUREMENTS:
  • The first widely reported sighting occurred November 15, 1966: Roger and Linda Scarberry and Steve and Mary Mallette saw a ~7-foot creature with glowing red eyes near the 'TNT area,' a decommissioned WWII ordnance works outside Point Pleasant, West Virginia.
  • Sightings were reported through 1967 and ended after the Silver Bridge collapse on December 15, 1967, which killed 46 people.
  • The name 'Mothman' was coined by an Ohio copy editor riffing on Batman, then on TV.
  • John Keel's 'The Mothman Prophecies' (1975, Saturday Review Press) tied the sightings to UFOs and Men in Black.
  • The NTSB's 1971 investigation blamed the bridge collapse on stress corrosion cracking in an eyebar — it never investigated Mothman.
